title: Zain Khan Falls and the Road to Sirhind Opens

blocks.text: The hidden movement fails, and Zain Khan is struck down in the exchange with the Khalsa. The location where wounded Zain Khan had fallen becomes identifiable through the cries of his own men, allowing the Singhs to press in and complete the collapse of organized resistance around him.

Even in victory, the narrative distinguishes between enemies who keep fighting and those who submit. Pathans who lay down arms are spared, while abandoned stores, animals, treasure, and artillery pass into Sikh hands.
This page closes the pursuit and opens the next act. With Zain Khan dead near Sirhind, the destruction of the city itself becomes the looming subject.
